source: OptimumG, OptimumKinematics - Generic FSAE Case Study (May 2015), http://downloads.optimumg.com/Technical_Papers/OptimumKinematics_Case_Study_Generic_Formula_Student_Car.pdf
conventions: mm, deg. Toe-out positive, camber positive = top outward, heave positive = chassis up (wheel rebound), steering wheel angle positive = turn left; rack travel = 85.788 mm per steering wheel revolution.
warning: Slides 81 and later belong to another car (wheelbase about 2570 mm); only slides 26-27, 33-34, 60-64, 68-72 are used.

heave.slides: 60 (camber), 68 (toe), legend UCM-15; values read from the plots

steer.slides: 62 (camber), 70 (toe), front left wheel; values read from the plots

not_compared: FV and SV swing arm lengths (definition not stated), the rear motion ratio (see motion_ratio)

motion_ratio.slides: 113 (Spring Motion Ratio - Heave, front left); values read from the plot
motion_ratio.definition: coil-over motion ratio, wheel displacement over coil-over displacement from the design position (secant); heave positive = chassis up
motion_ratio.rear_not_compared: the rear plot (1.67 at design) does not follow from the rear hardpoints under any pullrod attachment (upright, upper or lower arm: 0.73 at most); the rear rocker of the case study is not reproduced
